text: rust-jp とのマルチポストですが、rust-analyzer に「選択範囲の型を表示」機能が追加されたようですね　<https://github.com/rust-analyzer/rust-analyzer/pull/9693>

attachments.title: <https://github.com/rust-analyzer/rust-analyzer/pull/9693|#9693 feat: Add the Hover Range capability which enables showing the type of an expression>
attachments.text:
Closes <https://github.com/rust-analyzer/rust-analyzer/issues/389|rust-analyzer/rust-analyzer#389>

This PR extends the `textDocument/hover` method to allow getting the type of an expression. It looks like this:

<https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22298999/126914293-0ce49a92-545d-4005-a59e-9294fa2330d6.gif|type_of_expression>

Edit: One thing I noticed is that when hovering a selection that includes a macro it doesn't work, so maybe this would need a follow-up issue discussing what problem that may have.

(PS: What a great project! I am learning a lot! :rocket:)
